correctness.rationale: Orthogonal spectral projectors split constants, block contrasts and blockwise zero-sum modes with eigenvalues 0, Nb, and (N-n_i)b+n_i a_i. The derived exact off-diagonal rational expression has sign of P_i(h)=12n_i a_i+6n_i b lambda_i h+lambda_i((Nb)^2-(N-n_i)b lambda_i)h^2. Sign for all h>0 is exactly the leading coefficient condition; violation yields one and only one positive root. Inter-block entries and diagonal are strictly positive. Exact package-extracted matrix tests verify 3,636 cases; boundary and universal claims are proved algebraically.

originality.rationale: The inspected full primary texts concern general absolute-monotonicity obstructions and conditional finite-step positivity, not the arbitrary-number-of-blocks all-step hyperrectangle. Previously established special cases cover the unweighted complete multipartite case, separate matching-weight perturbations, and one clique joined to an independent set; they do not give simultaneous arbitrary-sized internally weighted blocks. The new statement is a strictly wider multi-parameter classification. Search incompleteness leaves publication-priority risk.
residual_risks: Specialist work on equitable partitions, block-homogeneous spectral filters or positive network discretizations may contain an equivalent multi-block result without matching searchable titles.
The classification uses classical spectral projectors; originality is a precise new high-dimensional block result, not the projector technique.

value.rationale: An exact natural high-dimensional robustness domain for arbitrarily many community conductances is a Cartesian product of independently sharp intervals despite global coupling. Its complete classification unifies two restricted earlier graph families and reveals no cross-community compensation, with precise individual failure steps; this is structurally informative for network diffusion discretization.
